body:
Dear friend,

The new book has arrived safely, thanks to you! Sam is reading it to everyone who'll listen.

He's making picture cards for the little ones. Will you come to the library and help him?
summary: Help Sam label his picture cards.

tasks.where: in the library in Bellhaven (walk the north road, or take the map)
at the coop by your house
in the grove behind the chapel
